description: Returns a one-time link that connects this conversation to a live BlockWerk browser tab. Opening it shows the current diagram and asks the user to allow the connection; after that the tools run on that tab, including simulations and their results. The link works once and expires after 10 minutes. When a tab is already connected, it says so instead.

link.description: BlockWerk share link (https://blockwerk.tech/?project=…) of the diagram, as returned by an earlier result. The connector rebuilds the diagram from it when it holds no diagram of its own.

name: connect_browser_tab
title: Connect a browser tab
